summary: Round-1 MAJOR baseline-order-unverified is resolved. AC#3 now feeds records sorted by sessionId to the single-argument statisticsView, which takes the order() branch. AC#5 builds `all` and every filtered set from the same sessionId-sorted copy, which takes the orderHands(all) branch. Repeating the round-1 mutation (g2Target(all.hands)) now fails 2 tests: AC#3 (expected 3.5 to be 3.1) and AC#5 ('All: expected 143.5 to be 3.1'). The source was restored and is unmodified. Round-1 MINOR line-up-filter-vacuous is also resolved. The 9-max pool is seated with configForLineUp(..., 'Tough'), which is the real config path and not forged records. The test asserts that the line-ups are exactly ['Custom', 'Tough'], and `sizes` now pins Custom 1200 and Tough 500. The fix diff (efce40a..00ab8ac) only adds or strengthens assertions: none were removed or loosened, and the existing expectedTarget(stored) and 3.1 checks are kept. The cashPool change is backward compatible (preset is optional, and the no-preset path is unchanged), and its other callers (bb100 acceptance, trend-data, the e2e seed) are unaffected. No source files changed in this round. The stats and trend-data tests pass (61 passed, 1 skipped), tsc and eslint are clean, and the fix-4 gate is PASS. The round-1 MINOR no-test-target-without-points is still open. There are no BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
